source: What AI lab and data buyers ask first: the BizLink AI-lab form (industry, size, data types, anonymized), the buyer-side Data Inventory workbook (language, sensitive data, ownership, prior sharing) and the Data Snapshot (volume, history, updates, ownership, contracts, uniqueness, exclusions). Keys shared with the Snapshot keep the same option keys. No sample-export question: the client is making the sample right now.
intro: These are the questions AI and data buyers ask first. Best guesses are fine.

name_question.help: Plain words are perfect, e.g. 'customer support tickets', 'store sales', 'patient visit records', 'project drawings' or 'machine sensor logs'.

questions.help: AI buyers price data by its form. Pick all that apply.

options.label: CAD, design files or source code

questions.prompt: Roughly how many records, files or documents?
questions.help: Across the whole data set, not just this sample. A rough band is fine.

questions.prompt: How many years of history does it cover?
Does new data keep coming in?
questions.help: Many buyers pay more for an ongoing feed than a one-time file.

options.label: Yes, continuously or in real time
No, it is mostly a historical archive

questions.prompt: Do the records show outcomes or expert decisions?
questions.help: For example a diagnosis, an approved claim, a fixed fault, a final price, a won deal or a reviewed design. AI buyers value these most.

questions.prompt: What language is the text in?
questions.help: Emails, documents, notes and records together.

options.label: Little or no text (numbers, images, sensor data)

company_questions.prompt: How many people work at the company?
company_questions.help: Some AI buyers only work with companies above a certain size.

options.label: We own it, collected with user consent
Mixed: some ours, some licensed from others

company_questions.prompt: Do any contracts stop you from sharing, licensing or selling this data?
company_questions.help: Customer agreements, NDAs, vendor terms, partner or platform licences.

options.label: Some limits, but we could share parts of it
Yes, contracts block sharing or selling it

company_questions.prompt: Do your customer terms or consents say anything about using the data for AI?
company_questions.help: Privacy policy, terms of service, patient or customer consent forms.

options.label: Yes, they allow AI, research or analytics use

company_questions.prompt: Is any of this in the full data set?
company_questions.help: Some buyers cannot take these, and others need them kept apart. This tool removes identifiers, but buyers still ask. Pick all that apply.

options.label: Payment card, bank or credit details
Data collected from other websites or bought lists

company_questions.prompt: Could a buyer get this data anywhere else?

options.label: Others could build it, but it would take years
Some of it is available from other sources

company_questions.prompt: Has this data already been sold, licensed or sent to anyone?
company_questions.help: Like a data buyer, broker or AI company. Fine if so: we plan around it.

options.label: Only a sample or a description
Yes, we have licensed or sold it
We are in talks with a buyer or broker

company_questions.prompt: Would you consider an exclusive deal?
company_questions.help: Some AI buyers pay more to be the only buyer for a set time.

company_questions.prompt: Is there anyone you won't sell or license to?
